title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - CustomerBill
description: The customer bill. Can be a regular recurring bill or an extra bill on demand by the customer or the csp. (TM Forum TMF678 CustomerBill 5.0.0, OpenAPI component CustomerBill; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:CustomerBill:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CustomerBill'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'CustomerBill' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Addressable/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:CustomerBill:<tmfId>. unique identifier

amountDue.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/amountDue'. A base / value business entity used to represent money

appliedPayment.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/appliedPayment'. Applied payment is a payment associated with the bill. There may be a partial payment, then there should be several applied payments available. On the other hand, more than one bill could be payed by one payment. In general there is an n:m relation between payment and bill.

billDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/billDate'. Bill date, external customer view (in consequence: different to the production date of the bill)

billDocument.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/billDocument'. The polymorphic attributes @type, @schemaLocation & @referredType are related to the Attachment entity and not the AttachmentRefOrValue class itself

billNo.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/billNo'. Bill reference known by the customer or the party and displayed on the bill. Could be different from the id

billingAccount.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/billingAccount'. BillingAccount reference. A BillingAccount is a detailed description of a bill structure. In TMF this is a BillingAccountRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced BillingAccount entity (urn:ngsi-ld:BillingAccount:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

billingPeriod.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/billingPeriod'. A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

billCycle.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/billCycle'. In TMF this is a BillCycleRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced BillCycle entity (urn:ngsi-ld:BillCycle:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

category.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/category'. Category of the bill produced : normal, duplicate, interim, last, trial customer or credit note for example

financialAccount.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/financialAccount'. AccountReceivable reference. An account of money owed by a party to another entity in exchange for goods or services that have been delivered or used. An account receivable aggregates the amounts of one or more party accounts (billing or settlement) owned by a given party. In TMF this is a FinancialAccountRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced FinancialAccount entity (urn:ngsi-ld:FinancialAccount:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

lastUpdate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/lastUpdate'. Date of bill last update

nextBillDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/nextBillDate'. ). Approximate date of the next bill production given for information (only used/meaningful for on cycle / regular bills)

paymentDueDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/paymentDueDate'. Date at which the amount due should have been paid

paymentMethod.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/paymentMethod'. PaymentMethod reference. A payment method defines a specific mean of payment (e.g direct debit). In TMF this is a PaymentMethodRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced PaymentMethod entity (urn:ngsi-ld:PaymentMethod:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

relatedParty.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/relatedParty'. RelatedParty reference. A related party defines party or party role or its reference, linked to a specific entity

remainingAmount.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/remainingAmount'. A base / value business entity used to represent money

runType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/runType'. Recommended Enumeration Type (not formal forced in standard): Valid values for the runType of a bill. The bill could be produced in a regular bill cycle 'onCycle'. Otherwise the bill is produced on a request (e.g. customer request). This could be indicated by 'offCycle'

taxExcludedAmount.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/taxExcludedAmount'. A base / value business entity used to represent money

taxIncludedAmount.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/taxIncludedAmount'. A base / value business entity used to represent money

taxItem.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/taxItem'. A tax item is created for each tax rate and tax type used in the bill.

state.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF678_CustomerBill/blob/v5.0.0/TMF678-CustomerBill-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/CustomerBill/properties/state'. Recommended Enumeration Type (not formal forced in standard): Valid values for the lifecycle state of the bill: new = 'bill is ready to validate or to sent', validated = 'bill is checked (manual / automatic)', sent = 'bill is sent with the channel defined in the billingaccount', settled = 'bill is payed', partiallySettled = 'bill is partially payed', onHold = 'bill will not be in further processing until open issues connected to the bill are solved'

AppliedPayment.description: The applied payment is the result of lettering process. It enables to assign automatically or manually part of incoming payment amount to a bill.
